label: predatory bacterium
definition: A trophic-ecology lifestyle in which a bacterium actively kills and consumes other bacteria for nutrients, e.g. the periplasmic predator Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus.
observations: Existing v5 parent ID and meaning; included for standalone hierarchy.

label: periplasmic bacterial predation
definition: A predatory bacterial phenotype in which a bacterium enters the periplasm of a bacterial prey cell and grows and reproduces there using nutrients obtained by killing and consuming the prey.
observations: Periplasmic residence with prey-derived growth and reproduction; not entry alone.
